extraction.quote_span: Snow is down to maybe a mile total near the hut, sun cupped but flat. Trail runners fine all day.

detail.quote: Snow is down to maybe a mile total near the hut, sun cupped but flat. Trail runners fine all day.
detail.text: Muir on 7/24. Snow is down to maybe a mile total near the hut, sun cupped but flat. Trail runners fine all day. Evolution Creek at the meadow is knee high and warm-ish. The lakes are melting out and it is the most beautiful place on earth right now.

detail.author: trailname_Sprocket
detail.text: Mather 7/13: south ramp is 90 percent melted, a switchbacking dirt path with two short snow crossings, no traction. Muir 7/15: couple miles of soft snow around the hut, flat, tedious, safe. Palisade Creek crossing knee high. The season flipped in two weeks.

extraction.quote_span: it was still waist deep at 8am

detail.quote: it was still waist deep at 8am
detail.text: Muir was fine, just endless. Snow for like 4 miles on each side of the hut, sun cups the whole way. No spikes needed by afternoon, it is so soft you just posthole. Evolution Creek was the real story, we crossed at the meadow alternate and it was still waist deep at 8am.
